_provenance: These two entries are REAL, PUBLIC, disclosed events — not synthetic. Sourced from UHG's own earnings releases/SEC filings and public reporting. They are the validation roadmap's anchor points.

anchors.description: Optum Health FY2025 operating earnings swung from $7.8B (FY2024) to a $278M loss, attributed by UHG to Medicare funding reductions and utilization pressure.
anchors.backtest_question: Would the framework's Capital/Demand driver baseline for Optum Health have shown elevated risk in early 2025, ahead of this disclosed outcome?

anchors.description: A February 2024 cyberattack on Change Healthcare (an Optum Insight subsidiary) caused a significant, disclosed operational and financial impact.
anchors.disclosed_in: UnitedHealth Group public disclosures and earnings commentary, 2024
anchors.backtest_question: Would the framework's Data_Digital driver baseline for Optum Insight have shown elevated risk ahead of this event, and would an overlay-extraction pass on early reporting have flagged it promptly?
